theoretical_framework_notes.summary: The majority of chronic degenerative conditions share a single field pattern: Shaoyin sink collapse (HT-KD weakness/freeze) → Taiyang expansion (BL-SI overload). All downstream manifestations (fibromyalgia, IIH, PRESS, CRPS, posterior fossa congestion, migraine, insomnia, skin eruptions, spinal disease) are phases of this central dissociation. Engine must check for this meta-pattern before assigning isolated diagnoses.

SP → HT → SI → BL → KD → PC is the communication direction of energy when healthy. Pathology arises when the relay flows but the switching (Yin-Yang polarity transfer) fails. The critical four-gate is HT → SI → BL → KD. Engine should identify where in the relay the blockage sits.

Pericardium can lock under trauma, preventing the heart from receiving field information. Dorsal vagus overactivates. Diastolic rigidity follows. This is the Shaoyin-Jueyin intersection freeze — a specific sub-pattern of the broader Shaoyin-Taiyang dissociation.

BL meridian is the electromagnetic network of dura mater + paravertebralis fascia. When HT closes, BL overloads. Interference discharges produce: paravertebral spasm, segmental pain nodes, fascia flashes, dura tension → headache, occipital neuralgia, posterior fossa sludging. This is the physical substrate of chronic pain in this pattern.

Yin (low frequency: HT Yin, KD Yin, Jing, EZ water) provides stable foundation. Yang (high frequency: SI, BL, visual system, fascia field) overactivates without Yin anchor. Jueyin (mid frequency: LR/PC, trauma, suppressed emotion) modulates signal distortion. When the three are not synchronised: non-local interference field → chronic disease.

Suan Zao Ren Tang calms fire but does not open venous return, resolve HT-KD dissociation, or nourish KD Yin-blood-Jing reserves. It is transitional sedation, not a Shaoyin reboot formula. Engine should flag if this formula is used as a primary Shaoyin restoration strategy.

Du Huo / Qiang Huo are pungent Yang-movers. Contraindicated in Yin-deficient patients and sensitive women (intraluminal microbleed, spotting risk). Bai Zhi is the safe alternative: gentle Taiyang mover, Yin-sensitive, does not move blood, suitable for evening formula. Du Huo optional only when Taiyang layer confirmed full and tense in robust patients.

In every chronic degenerative process, the Shaoyin sink must be rebooted first. Cellular level: mitochondria. Psychological level: hope. Spiritual level: soul-body integration. The Shaoyin Sink Re-entry Formula addresses all three simultaneously via the herb groups: HT-KD bridge, Yin builders, Jueyin openers.
